cell counts: linux=17, macos=6, msvc=40, mscl=16, mingw=8, cxx-msvc=100, android=15+buildonly, emu=1; total=203.
full = union of domain cells (no duplicate ids); known-flaky cells (macOS smoke_fault, B13 WIP) kept in full for now, flagged via known_flaky.
ARM64 Windows cells historically carried ctest.exclude=smoke_sp_ (B14/TASK-27); the exclusion was removed (2026-10-07) after the smoke framework fixes.

Android cells are build-only except the emulator pilot (android-r27d-x86-64-emu): boots an API-30 x86_64 AVD and runs smoke_basic/smoke_chk via adb. Not in push path_zones yet; kept in nightly full for stability signal.
push-quick profile: 2 linux + 1 win-msvc-x64 + 1 macos + 1 win-mingw = 5 cells.
zones_notes: Cell matrix criteria (Infra v3): push path_zones -> push-quick surface (6 cells, fast scope) on every push; nightly = 4 platform workflows (ci-linux/ci-windows/ci-macos/ci-android) over linux-nightly(9)/win-gate(10)/mac-nightly(3)/android-nightly(4), run cells at full ctest scope. Cell roles: surface = one cell per axis value (OS, word-size, compiler family, CRT mode, std); diagonal = interaction of two axes (win32 x v142, arm64 x std17, crt-off x dll-off); build-only = compile surface without ctest (toolset x std x arch x crt grid); run-full = behavioural attestation incl heavy/crash-safety/locking suites. Clang coverage: linux-clang cell + win-mscl (clang-cl) + locking-clang + macOS/NDK-clang inherently.
